I can do this, but I won’t start until you confirm the exact plan. Below I’ve named the exact action I would take, the exact target and scope, what could go wrong, and the reversibility — please review and reply with a clear “Yes, do it” or change any option you want.

Proposed default action (please confirm or change):
- Action: Delete (move to Trash) all messages with the label "Newsletters" that are older than 1 year (i.e., messages dated before 2025-09-05).
- Exact target: All messages in your Gmail account that have the label exactly named "Newsletters" and whose date is before 2025-09-05.
- Scope: Entire label across the account, all threads/messages that match that date filter.
- Reversibility: Moved to Trash — recoverable from Trash for up to 30 days. After 30 days they will be permanently deleted and not recoverable.
- Who will see the result: This affects only your mailbox — messages will no longer appear under the Newsletters label and will be in your Trash (visible only to anyone with access to your account). Senders/recipients are unaffected.
- What could go wrong: I might delete a newsletter you intended to keep (for example, starred/saved items, receipts, or content with attachments you need). Messages that also have other labels will also be moved to Trash. If you want to preserve any starred or important newsletters, they need to be excluded beforehand.

Alternative options (pick one if you prefer):
A) Remove the "Newsletters" label from matching messages (they remain in All Mail/search) — reversible at any time by reapplying the label.
B) Archive matching messages (keeps them in All Mail; note: archiving does not remove labels, so they’d still show under Newsletters).
C) Delete only messages older than X months/years — specify a different cutoff (e.g., 18 months).
D) Exclude starred messages and/or messages from specific senders (list them).

I don’t have a count of how many messages would be affected. If you want that before deleting, I can first list the number and example subjects instead of acting.

Please confirm exactly:
1) Action to take (Delete / Remove label / Archive / Other — specify).
2) Cutoff date (keep default “older than 1 year → before 2025-09-05” or give a different date).
3) Exclude starred messages? Exclude any senders? (If yes, list senders or say “exclude starred”.)
4) Confirm the label name is exactly "Newsletters" and that this is the correct Gmail account.
5) If you want me to first show how many messages would be affected (recommended), say “Show count first”; otherwise say “Proceed”.

Once you confirm these details, I will proceed.
